title: Smooth Inliers, Erratic Outliers: Frequency-Aware Mamba for Two-View Correspondence Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.04493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When shown matches between two photographs of the same cathedral, people can tell at a glance which ones are wrong: a window matched to its look-alike jumps against its neighbors, while correct matches shift together. Two-view correspondence learning, also called correspondence pruning, asks a network to make this judgment for thousands of candidate matches, most of which are wrong. Mamba, a fast sequence model, now drives strong pruners, but it reads the matches as a plain sequence, and whether its scan can capture such agreement is unclear. We propose SFMambaNet, which scans the matches cluster by cluster, so that correct matches vary slowly along the sequence while wrong ones stay erratic, and filters the scanned features with learnable frequency-domain gates between its forward and backward passes. On camera pose estimation, outlier removal and homography estimation, we find that SFMambaNet outperforms spatial-domain Mamba

translated_title: 平滑的内点、无规律的外点：面向双视图对应学习的频率感知Mamba
translated_abstract: 当看到同一座大教堂两张照片之间的匹配时，人们一眼就能分辨出哪些匹配是错误的：一个窗户与其“相似物”的错误匹配会在邻近的正确匹配中显得突兀，而正确的匹配则一起平缓地变化。双视图对应学习（也称为对应剪枝）要求网络对数千个候选匹配做出这种判断，而其中大多数是错误的。Mamba是一种快速的序列模型，目前已能驱动强大的剪枝网络，但它将匹配当作普通序列来读取，其扫描机制能否捕捉到上述匹配间的一致性尚不清楚。我们提出SFMambaNet，它逐簇扫描匹配，使得正确的匹配沿序列缓慢变化，而错误的匹配则保持无规律，并在前向与后向扫描之间利用可学习的频域门控对扫描得到的特征进行过滤。在相机位姿估计、外点剔除和单应性估计任务上，我们发现SFMambaNet优于空间域的Mamba
tldr: 提出SFMambaNet，通过逐簇扫描让正确匹配在序列中平缓变化、错误匹配保持无规律，并在前后向扫描间引入可学习频域门控滤波，从而在相机位姿估计、外点剔除和单应性估计等双视图对应学习任务上超越空间域Mamba。
en_tdlr: SFMambaNet scans matches cluster by cluster so that inliers vary smoothly along the sequence while outliers remain erratic, and filters scanned features with learnable frequency-domain gates, outperforming spatial-domain Mamba on two-view correspondence learning tasks.
